desc: Ideation: functional graph = cycles with in-trees; cycle nodes equal; DP with prefix sums gives O(N·M) solution.
Reconcile formula with sample 2 (sum of v^3 = 2025 confirms DP approach, not simple binomial).
Implement input parsing and graph construction (out[i] = A_i, children adjacency).
Kahn elimination to identify cycle nodes and elimination order.
Bottom-up DP: f_u[v] = ∏_{c child of u} prefix_f_c[v], computed for all nodes (tree nodes via elimination order, cycle nodes after their children are done).
Group cycle nodes by cycle; component count = sum_v ∏_{r in cycle} g_r[v]; multiply all components.
Check against samples: sample 1 (2-cycle {1,2} plus leaf 3 on 1: g_1 = (1,2,3), g_2 = (1,1,1), sum = 6 ✓); sample 2 (self-loop at 1 with 3 leaves: sum_v v^3 = 2025 ✓); sample 3 logic consistent.
Output final code with fast I/O, mod 998244353, iterative implementation.
